subject: Spot uplift request + blended true-up — pricing confirmation and PO path
messages:
From: Samir Shah <samir@brightlane.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@brightlane.com
Date: 2026-08-05T09:17:00-07:00
Subject: Urgent: short notice quota uplift for launch spike

Hi Marissa —

Quick one: we have a public-facing feature launch on Wednesday that just got accelerated. Our infra team projects a 6–8x spike in token consumption for the first 48 hours. We can’t risk throttling.

Can Redwood provide a 48-hour spot uplift (delta ~600k tokens/day) and confirm what the blended overrun price would be if we exceed the committed tier? Procurement needs a PO path and a single-line item for the uplift + any true-up.

I attached our latest usage extract.

Thanks,
Samir
Samir Shah
Head of Platform, Brightlane
procurement@brightlane.com

Attachments: Brightlane_weekly-usage.csv (CSV, 72KB)

From: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Shah <samir@brightlane.com>
Cc: jonas_weber <jonas@redwood.ai>, lauren_bishop <lauren@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-05T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Urgent: short notice quota uplift for launch spike

Samir — thanks for the heads up and the attachment. We can cover the uplift; want to align on three things quickly so procurement has clean language:

1) Uplift window: 48h starting 2026-08-07 00:00 UTC (you confirm start).
2) Coverage: temporary quota delta of 1.2M tokens total over 48h (we'll provision as an ephemeral "spot uplift").
3) Pricing: we can offer a one-time spot uplift rate at 1.25x of your current committed per-token rate, with any residual overrun beyond the uplift reconciled at a blended monthly true-up rate of 1.1x committed rate.

If that works, I’ll draft the PO line items and loop legal/finance for quick sign-off. CC’ing Jonas (finance) and Lauren (solutions) to confirm the billing flow and any constraints.

Could you confirm the start time and whether Brightlane wants the uplift charged upfront or invoiced on the next monthly true-up?

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Lead, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0172

Quote: "We can offer a 48h spot uplift at 1.25x committed rate; blended true-up at 1.1x."

From: Samir Shah <samir@brightlane.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@brightlane.com
Date: 2026-08-05T12:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Urgent: short notice quota uplift for launch spike

Thanks Marissa — start time confirmed: start 2026-08-07 00:00 UTC. Procurement prefers invoicing on next monthly true-up (not prepaid). Also requesting a one-off 10% concession on the uplift premium because this was an accelerated ask.

Can you 1) confirm the invoice flow (single PO line vs. uplift as separate line), and 2) send a brief pricing wording that procurement can attach to the PO?

Samir

From: jonas_weber <jonas@redwood.ai>
To: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, lauren_bishop <lauren@redwood.ai>, Samir Shah <samir@brightlane.com>
Date: 2026-08-06T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Urgent: short notice quota uplift for launch spike

Marissa/Samir — quick finance note here so procurement has clarity:

- Spot uplift pricing: Marissa’s suggestion (1.25x committed) is fine as an operational uplift.
- Concession: we can accept a one-time 10% concession on the uplift premium for this emergency (effective uplift multiplier becomes 1.125x for the 48h). This is a one-off and does not affect base committed rates.
- Invoice flow: create two PO line items — (A) "48h spot uplift — token allowance" (quantity = 1, price = uplift delta * uplift multiplier) and (B) "Monthly true-up — blended overrun" (placeholder; we reconcile actual token usage and apply 1.1x blended rate to any usage beyond committed plus uplift). We’ll issue the invoice on the normal monthly cadence.

I’ll have finance generate a short pricing blurb for the PO. Lauren, can you confirm the technical provisioning steps so we can guarantee the uplift window?

—Jonas
Jonas Weber
Head of Finance, Redwood Inference
jonas@redwood.ai

Date: 2026-08-06T12:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Urgent: short notice quota uplift for launch spike — PO wording and docs

Samir/procurement —

Attached is the PO draft and the two-line pricing blurb Jonas requested. Summary below for the PO:

PO line 1 — "48h Spot Uplift: Ephemeral token allowance for launch window (2026-08-07 00:00 UTC to 2026-08-09 00:00 UTC). Quantity: 1. Rate: uplift delta priced at 1.125x of Brightlane’s committed per-token rate (one-time uplift premium after agreed 10% concession)."

PO line 2 — "Monthly True-up: Any usage beyond committed + uplift allowance in the calendar month will be reconciled at a blended rate of 1.1x the committed per-token rate and invoiced on the next monthly invoice."

Procurement action items: please attach PO to next invoice cycle, sign the attached PDF, and confirm billing contact.

Lauren — can you confirm provisioning steps? We need to flip the ephemeral quota on at 00:00 UTC 2026-08-07 and verify metrics are reporting to Brightlane’s dashboard (we’ll send an alert if QPS approaches throttling).

Thanks,
Marissa

Attachments: Brightlane_PO_draft.pdf (PDF, 48KB)

From: Samir Shah <samir@brightlane.com>

Cc: procurement@brightlane.com, jonas_weber <jonas@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Urgent: short notice quota uplift for launch spike — PO wording and docs

Marissa/Jonas/Lauren —

All good from procurement; PO signed and attached. We will not prepay — please invoice on the August monthly true-up. Appreciate the concession and fast turn.

We’ll monitor and reach out if we see any anomalies during the window. Please confirm once the ephemeral quota is active.

Best,
Samir
